name: Local Convex Hull (LCH)
definition: A surface reconstruction method that constructs triangular patches from an octree by estimating a surface from local convexities, assuming the object is piecewise convex and surfaces are tightly connected.
summary: Local Convex Hull is a surface reconstruction method that creates continuous triangular meshes from volumetric data by enforcing connectivity, distinguishing itself from Delaunay triangulation by using convex hull algorithms.
